Name: Adomin8er's Portrait Background Framework
Author: Adomin8er
Description:
DISCORD:
Adomin8er's Modding Server → [url=https://discord.com/channels/1380179574343864441/1562355465554231296]sdv-portrait-background-framework[/url]

Mod Purpose:
Adds customizable backgrounds behind Stardew Valley portraits and supports portrait assets of any resolution. Backgrounds can be provided through Content Patcher and configured to change based on location, season, weather, time, or other conditions.

Recommendation:
For the intended experience, play with the accompanying [b]HD Portrait Backgrounds[/b] content pack along with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42320]Adomin8er's HD Portraits and Genderbend[/url] mod.

Development notes:
A lot of AI was used during development, along with extensive manual work, testing, configuration, and refinement.

Extracting:
The folder system and naming scheme can sometimes cause issues due to length and where the files are being extracted. If you encounter this issue consider trying 7zip to extract.

Disclaimer:
This is a first round release. I'm sure there will be bugs to fix.
